problem: Lower-certify log-scale curvature C_tt(theta)=E_q[(p_theta/p_rho) H_t(z)] over the standardized Gaussian null rectangle for the frozen m=32 NIG predictive numerator and symmetric four-corner denominator candidate. This is the first of the two compact curvature obligations from r88.

validated_structure.q_cell_extrema: Closed form: q decreases with y^2; for fixed y^2 it is unimodal in W with stationary point W*=2*(29/2)*(2+y^2/(2a))/(19-29/2). Cell extrema therefore occur at that clipped W* or W endpoints.
validated_structure.numerator_cell_extrema: For A=W+32(y-mu)^2, log f=-32 log sigma-A/(2sigma^2); the cell maximum occurs at clipped sigma=sqrt(A_low/32), and the minimum occurs at a sigma endpoint using A_high.
validated_structure.denominator_cell_extrema: For each fixed corner scale, the symmetric y-factor is even and strictly decreasing in |y| because 32 h^2/s^2<1; W is monotone decreasing. Hence exact cell extrema use |y| and W endpoints.
validated_structure.kernel_cell_extrema: z is interval-bounded by A_low/sigma_high^2 and A_high/sigma_low^2; H_t is convex with its minimum at z=33 when the interval contains 33.
validated_structure.sign_safe_product_rule: On cells with H_low>=0 use q_low R_low H_low; otherwise use q_high R_high H_low. Omitted points outside the compact domain are nonnegative by r88 and require no tail penalty.

roundoff_guard.kind: deliberately inflated binary64 enclosure screen, not formal directed-rounding proof
roundoff_guard.details: Parameter and integration boxes were expanded by epsilon; positive lower factors were deflated, negative/upper factors inflated, H_low shifted downward by epsilon*(1+|H_low|), and cell volumes were sign-guarded. This is much larger than ordinary floating roundoff but does not constitute a proof about libm transcendental implementations.

results.interpretation: The monotone box enclosure remains strictly positive with >7 nat margin at 260x260 resolution and strengthens under refinement. This closes the mathematical cell-bounding route and strongly localizes the only remaining certification gap to machine-directed transcendental rounding, not parameter or predictive tails.

negative_or_scope_evidence: Do not promote the four-corner factor yet. The enclosure is mathematically conservative at the box level but the exp/log/cosh evaluations used standard binary64 libm rather than a directed-rounding interval library.
rho was screened at 0.55441744; positivity has not yet been certified uniformly over the final directed-rounding rho bracket.
C_mumu remains unclosed. The r88 beta-prime tail reduction still leaves its compact integral to certify.
All statements remain restricted to the standardized frozen m=32 NIG predictor and iid Gaussian null rectangle.
new_result: C_tt compact positivity is no longer a broad validated-numerics problem: a deterministic monotone cell enclosure with large positive slack exists. The next proof task can focus narrowly on reproducing the same sum with truly outward-rounded transcendental evaluations or an independently validated interval backend.
frontier: Recompute the r89 C_tt enclosure with an actual directed-rounding/interval transcendental backend, preferably only near the small set of worst parameter cells because the current box margin is large everywhere.
Certify C_tt uniformly over a narrow rho bracket around the active-pair root rather than at a single rho screen value.

Return to C_mumu: use the exact beta-prime W-tail penalty from r88, but tighten p_theta/p_rho jointly in W to avoid the loose independent numerator/denominator interval blow-up seen in a first attempt.

If that preserves positivity, mark C_tt machine-certified and immediately derive a W-coupled log-ratio bound for the negative C_mumu strip so the r88 compact mean-curvature integral can be enclosed without catastrophic tail dependency.
